location: INT. MAIN DECK (HOVERCRAFT) and INT. RESTAURANT - NIGHT
summary: On the main deck of the hovercraft, Cypher pours Neo a shot of Dozer's homemade liquor, which Neo finds harsh. Cypher reveals that Morpheus has previously identified five other candidates for 'the One,' all of whom died fighting Agents. He advises Neo to run from Agents rather than fight them. The scene cuts to a restaurant where Cypher, dining with Agent Smith, admits the steak is a simulation but enjoys it, declaring 'Ignorance is bliss' as they negotiate a deal involving Morpheus.

what_changes.before: Unaware of previous failures or the specific danger of Agents
what_changes.after: Informed that five previous candidates died fighting Agents and that running is the standard survival tactic
what_changes.evidence: Five. Since I've been here. ... Dead. All dead. ... you see an Agent, you [...].

what_changes.before: Appears to be a crew member, though cynical
what_changes.after: Revealed to be in a deal with Agent Smith, prioritizing comfort ('rich', 'actor') over resistance

event_hint.one_line: Cypher warns Neo about the fate of previous 'Ones' and simultaneously finalizes his betrayal of the crew with Agent Smith.

uncertain: The specific terms of the deal regarding the 'access codes' are mentioned but the full scope of the betrayal's immediate impact on the ship is not shown in this scene.
